q: 1. The sum of the interior angles of a geometrical figure laid on the surface of the earth differs from that of the corresponding plane figure only to the extent of one second for every ...............
explain: In geodetic surveying, the spherical excess (difference in angles) is 1 second for every 195.5 sq. km of area; since 195.5 is not an option, 'none of these' is selected.
